title: Document attachment arguments, version 1
description: The canonical arguments a caller hands /acquire for the documents source, and the adapter reads on stdin (docs/design/attachments.md). Written within the descriptor grammar version 1 of docs/design/tool-descriptors.md: objects with primitive fields, no reference or identifier keyword, no format, no pattern.

mediaType.description: type/subtype, lowercase RFC 6838 restricted names, each part 1 to 127 characters, no parameters; a declaration outside that syntax is refused; version 1 processes application/pdf, text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv and application/json, and any other declaration within the syntax is recorded as media-type-unsupported

bytes.description: the document in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4), padded, no line breaks

sha256.description: optional: the caller's own digest of the bytes, "sha256:" + 64 lowercase hex; refused when it does not match

ocr.description: auto (default): run the configured OCR program for pages with no text layer; never: report them as needing it
